# Vitest Gotchas

> Known Vitest patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [A dynamic import inside a test body is billed to that test's timeout](dynamic-import-in-test-body.md): `await import()` in an `it()` body charges Vite's resolve+transform of the whole graph to the 5s per-test budget, so a test doing a millisecond of work fails randomly under full-suite load and its calls then poison the next test's spies; static imports are still mocked because `vi.mock` hoists above them, but anything a mock factory closes over must move into `vi.hoisted()`. HIGH.
- [Coverage without an explicit `include` measures only the files your tests import, and rises when you delete one](coverage-include-unset-measures-only-imports.md): `coverage.include` defaults to files loaded during the run, so untested files leave the denominator entirely and the percentage goes UP when you drop a module from the import graph; one repo read 84% over 91 of 284 files and 28% once `include` was set. With no `thresholds` block the run cannot fail either, and if CI calls a script without `--coverage` nothing is enforced at all. `all: true` is the removed Vitest 1.x mechanism and does not fix it. HIGH.
- [SQLite route tests persist state unless the central database module is mocked](sqlite-route-tests-persist-state-unless-the-central-database-module-is-mocked.md): Selecting the SQLite driver can still open a cwd-derived persistent file, so fixed test identities accumulate and parallel workers contend across reused runs; hoist a per-file in-memory mock before importing the route graph. HIGH.
- [A negative text assertion goes vacuous when the text it names changes](negative-text-assertion-vacuous-after-copy-change.md): `not.toContain("Old Copy")` can never fail once the copy changes, so it passes whatever renders; assert a structural hook, and grep negatives on the old string when changing copy. HIGH.
- [@cloudflare/vitest-plugin needs Vitest ^4.1, not the latest major](cloudflare-vitest-plugin-requires-vitest-4-1.md): The Workers test integration (renamed from @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers) peers on Vitest ^4.1; installing 'latest' Vitest (5) breaks it. Pin vitest ^4.1 until the plugin supports 5. MEDIUM.
- [Moving dynamic imports from test bodies to module scope reveals hidden dependencies](module-scope-imports-global-state.md): Hoisting await import() breaks if product modules read globals as they load; set up fake globals BEFORE module-scope imports, and use probes to validate initialization. HIGH.
